It shows three things: (1) a small rectangular stationer's stamp, upper left: 'E. Fritsche / Papierhandlung / Göttingen.' This is the shop that sold the blank notebook. (2) A pasted library slip: 'Auch als Mikroform vorhanden unter Sign.: MF/Cod.Ms.Hilbert 600:3.' This notes that a microform copy exists under the shelfmark MF/Cod.Ms.Hilbert 600:3; the '600:3' is handwritten. (3) A blue ownership stamp at the bottom: 'Niedersächsische Staats- u. Universitätsbibliothek Göttingen.' The cloth hinge of the binding is visible at the right. There are no derivations to reconstruct.
